meta.name: roadmap-planning
meta.description: Plan a strategic roadmap across prioritization, epic definition, stakeholder alignment, and sequencing. Use when turning strategy into a release plan that teams can execute.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将战略转化为可执行的发布计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把战略拆解成团队能执行的发布计划
copy.tagline_en: Turn strategy into an executable release plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn strategy into a release plan that teams can execute

howto.what: 这个技能会引导你一步步制定产品路线图：先收集业务目标和客户问题，再定义史诗级功能并排序，最后按季度排期并生成汇报材料。
howto.when: 当你需要把战略转化为可执行的发布计划时触发，例如季度或半年度规划、新利益相关者对齐方向时。

say.text: 帮我规划我们移动App未来两个季度的路线图。
say.note: 技能会引导你输入OKR和候选功能列表。

say.text: 我有15个待办事项，需要排出一个Q2路线图给高管审批。
say.note: 技能会帮你排序、定义史诗并生成汇报。

howto.what_en: This skill guides you step-by-step to create a strategic roadmap: gather business goals and customer problems, define epics with hypotheses, prioritize them, sequence into quarters, and produce a presentation for stakeholders.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to turn strategy into an executable release plan, e.g., during quarterly or half-year planning, or when aligning new stakeholders on direction.

say_en.text: Plan a 2-quarter roadmap for our mobile app.
say_en.note: The skill will ask for OKRs and candidate initiatives.

say_en.text: I have 15 competing initiatives and need a Q2 roadmap for exec approval.
say_en.note: The skill will prioritize, define epics, and generate a presentation.
